gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.1: Ice cream at the Guhfy Guhber (west)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.0: Mr. Krabguh has big news for everybody. Go to The Krusty Nibble.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.1: Spongeguh is a bit sad. Patguh knows what to do: ice cream! Go to the Guhfy Guhber ice cream parlour, west of the square, and take a seat at the bar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.2: A horn sounds on the square. King Neptuguh is in town, and he is furious. Hurry to the square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3: Get into the Patty Wagon in front of The Krusty Nibble, drive out of the town gate (east) and follow the road to The Thug Tug.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.3_b: Drive east along the road. Stay on the road: the Patty Wagon stops by itself at an edge.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4: A tough Mika took the key of the Patty Wagon and fell asleep at his table. Take it back without anybody seeing you move.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.4_b: Stand still when the Mikas look up! Only move when nobody is looking.
